chunk.title: THE HUNGRY FOX STUCK IN THE TREE HOLE
chunk.text: Tia, Tia

chunk.title: THE HUNGRY FOX STUCK IN THE TREE HOLE
chunk.text: Hey Tofu, guess what?

chunk.title: THE HUNGRY FOX STUCK IN THE TREE HOLE
chunk.text: I just bought a remote driven car from Hull.

chunk.title: THE HUNGRY FOX STUCK IN THE TREE HOLE
chunk.text: What? Why?

chunk.title: THE HUNGRY FOX STUCK IN THE TREE HOLE
chunk.text: He said he wanted to sell his car.

chunk.title: THE HUNGRY FOX STUCK IN THE TREE HOLE
chunk.text: I said I will buy it.

chunk.title: THE HUNGRY FOX STUCK IN THE TREE HOLE
chunk.text: He gave me a good deal on it too.

chunk.title: THE HUNGRY FOX STUCK IN THE TREE HOLE
chunk.text: Have you ever seen this car Tofu?

chunk.title: THE HUNGRY FOX STUCK IN THE TREE HOLE
chunk.text: No, but what could be wrong?

chunk.title: THE HUNGRY FOX STUCK IN THE TREE HOLE
chunk.text: Well, nothing, but it is always nice to know what you are getting into.

chunk.title: THE HUNGRY FOX STUCK IN THE TREE HOLE
chunk.text: Oh, you worry too much Tia.

chunk.title: THE HUNGRY FOX STUCK IN THE TREE HOLE
chunk.text: Maybe, but the Hungry Fox learned the other way.

chunk.title: THE HUNGRY FOX STUCK IN THE TREE HOLE
chunk.text: What do you mean?

chunk.title: THE HUNGRY FOX STUCK IN THE TREE HOLE
chunk.text: The Hungry Fox stuck in the tree hole.

chunk.title: THE HUNGRY FOX STUCK IN THE TREE HOLE
chunk.text: Once upon a time, a Hungry Fox roamed in the forest.

chunk.title: THE HUNGRY FOX STUCK IN THE TREE HOLE
chunk.text: He was very hungry and there was no food to be found.

chunk.title: THE HUNGRY FOX STUCK IN THE TREE HOLE
chunk.text: There is no food anywhere today.

chunk.title: THE HUNGRY FOX STUCK IN THE TREE HOLE
chunk.text: I shall go to the outskirts of the forest where the village starts

chunk.title: THE HUNGRY FOX STUCK IN THE TREE HOLE
chunk.text: and see if there is something to eat there.

chunk.title: THE HUNGRY FOX STUCK IN THE TREE HOLE
chunk.text: The Fox walked to the edge of the forest and entered the village area.

chunk.title: THE HUNGRY FOX STUCK IN THE TREE HOLE
chunk.text: There he found a big tree with a hole in its trunk.

chunk.title: THE HUNGRY FOX STUCK IN THE TREE HOLE
chunk.text: Curious, he looked into the hole.

chunk.title: THE HUNGRY FOX STUCK IN THE TREE HOLE
chunk.text: Wow! There is food in there.

chunk.title: THE HUNGRY FOX STUCK IN THE TREE HOLE
chunk.text: Bread, fresh jam, fruits.

chunk.title: THE HUNGRY FOX STUCK IN THE TREE HOLE
chunk.text: The food had been stored by a villager who was farming nearby.

chunk.title: THE HUNGRY FOX STUCK IN THE TREE HOLE
chunk.text: The Fox quickly jumped into the hole in the tree trunk

chunk.title: THE HUNGRY FOX STUCK IN THE TREE HOLE
chunk.text: and ate everything that the farmer had kept there.

chunk.title: THE HUNGRY FOX STUCK IN THE TREE HOLE
chunk.text: Music

chunk.title: THE HUNGRY FOX STUCK IN THE TREE HOLE
chunk.text: That was a good meal.

chunk.title: THE HUNGRY FOX STUCK IN THE TREE HOLE
chunk.text: My stomach is full now.

chunk.title: THE HUNGRY FOX STUCK IN THE TREE HOLE
chunk.text: But I am thirsty.

chunk.title: THE HUNGRY FOX STUCK IN THE TREE HOLE
chunk.text: Time to go and drink some water from the river.

chunk.title: THE HUNGRY FOX STUCK IN THE TREE HOLE
chunk.text: The Fox got ready to jump out of the tree trunk

chunk.title: THE HUNGRY FOX STUCK IN THE TREE HOLE
chunk.text: but as much as he tried, he couldn't.

chunk.title: THE HUNGRY FOX STUCK IN THE TREE HOLE
chunk.text: He was stuck in it.

chunk.title: THE HUNGRY FOX STUCK IN THE TREE HOLE
chunk.text: His stomach was now so fat that it got caught in the hole

chunk.title: THE HUNGRY FOX STUCK IN THE TREE HOLE
chunk.text: and he could not come out of it as much as he tried.

chunk.title: THE HUNGRY FOX STUCK IN THE TREE HOLE
chunk.text: Oh no! I am stuck.

chunk.title: THE HUNGRY FOX STUCK IN THE TREE HOLE
chunk.text: The villager will come back anytime and I will be in so much trouble.

chunk.title: THE HUNGRY FOX STUCK IN THE TREE HOLE
chunk.text: I wish I had thought a little before eating all that food.

chunk.title: THE HUNGRY FOX STUCK IN THE TREE HOLE
chunk.text: I think I am behaving like the Fox dear.

chunk.title: THE HUNGRY FOX STUCK IN THE TREE HOLE
chunk.text: Yes, you've got that right.

chunk.title: THE HUNGRY FOX STUCK IN THE TREE HOLE
chunk.text: Giving your action some thought before you jump in

chunk.title: THE HUNGRY FOX STUCK IN THE TREE HOLE
chunk.text: can go a long way in helping you out.

chunk.title: THE HUNGRY FOX STUCK IN THE TREE HOLE
chunk.text: You are right.

chunk.title: THE HUNGRY FOX STUCK IN THE TREE HOLE
chunk.text: Tomorrow before I pay hall for the car

chunk.title: THE HUNGRY FOX STUCK IN THE TREE HOLE
chunk.text: I will request him to show it to me.

chunk.title: THE HUNGRY FOX STUCK IN THE TREE HOLE
chunk.text: Good idea.

chunk.title: THE HUNGRY FOX STUCK IN THE TREE HOLE
chunk.text: Now please help me refill the watering can.
